verdict: AI custom-silicon supercycle intact (AVGO AI $10.8B record, CRDO +157% rev); post-earnings sell-offs and HBM ASP softening signal peak-cycle caution; Section 232 solar catalyst imminent.
body_md:
## Fresh developments (last 24-72h)

**DRAM/Memory pricing** — TrendForce (June 1): Q1-2026 DRAM industry revenue +81% QoQ on 93-98% price surge. Q2 decelerates to +58-63% DRAM / +70-75% NAND — still strong but first moderation print. HBM ASP growth beginning to compress: first concrete confirmation of the baseline correction-risk signal.

**AVGO earnings (June 3)** — Q2 FY2026: AI revenue record $10.8B; total revenue $22.2B (+48% YoY). Q3 guided $29.4B (+84% YoY; AI segment expected $16B). Negative post-close reaction: software segment missed; CEO Hock Tan did NOT raise FY2027 $100B AI target. Stock fell after hours.

**CRDO earnings (June 1)** — Q4 FY2026: revenue $437M (+157% YoY), EPS $1.16 vs. $1.02 est — beat on both lines. FY2027 guided >80% growth with optical products >$600M. Stock -12% after hours on beat-and-retreat dynamics. Company simultaneously announced acquisition of DustPhotonics for $750M (silicon photonics/CPO portfolio expansion).

**Solar** — FSLR hit an 18-year intraday high (~$310, May 28); solar stocks +40% YTD on Section 232 tariff speculation. Announcement expected mid-to-late June; measures may include a minimum import price alongside tariffs.

**HIVE/BUZZ** — FY2026 results: revenue $297.8M (+158% YoY); BUZZ HPC contracted ARR $35M; first B200 cluster live at Bell Canada facility at $2.90/GPU-hr (32% above plan). 320MW AI Gigafactory announced in Greater Toronto Area (CAD $3.5B; >100K NVIDIA GPUs; operations target 2H-2027).

**Optical** — No fresh 24-72h print beyond CRDO move. DustPhotonics acquisition is the key optical-adjacent catalyst. InP supply tight; LITE remains only volume 200G/lane EML supplier. CPO still pre-scale.

**AMD/Custom ASIC** — No new MI400/Helios update (2H-2026 on track per Feb 2026 confirmation). OpenAI signed large Trainium capacity commitment with AWS (~2 GW). Broadcom confirmed building OpenAI custom ASIC starting 2026.

**Hyperscaler capex** — No guide-down signal. Aggregate 2026 tracking $700B+: Amazon $200B, Google $175-185B, Microsoft $110-120B, Meta $115-135B.

---

## Watchlist movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|---|---|---|
| AVGO | ↓ after hours | Q2 FY2026: AI revenue record $10.8B, but software miss + no FY2027 target raise |
| CRDO | -12% after hours | Q4 FY2026 beat (+157% rev) but sell-the-news; $750M DustPhotonics acquisition |
| MRVL | +~4% | Jensen Huang called MRVL "next trillion-dollar company" at Computex |
| MU | +~3% (recent) | Pricing supercycle momentum; Q3 FY2026 earnings June 24 approaching |
| FSLR | +40%+ YTD | Section 232 tariff decision expected mid-to-late June |
| HIVE | N/A direct | FY2026 beat (+158%); B200 cluster live above plan; 320MW AI Gigafactory (GTA) |

---

## Context vs. baseline

DRAM Q1 revenue +81% QoQ tracks ahead of annual baseline; Q2 deceleration to +58-63% is the first moderating print — prices remain elevated but the inflection has arrived. HBM ASP compression is the earliest real-world confirmation of the baseline's most critical warning: correction after 2026. Hyperscaler capex is at the upper end of the $600-700B baseline. Custom ASIC displacement (OpenAI/Trainium + OpenAI/AVGO ASIC) is accelerating, compounding pressure on NVDA long-term share.

---

## Signals flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bull/Bear |
|---|---|---|
| DRAM Q2 pricing | Decelerating from Q1 peak | Moderating bull |
| HBM ASP 2026 | Softening confirmed | Bear (correction risk materializing) |
| Hyperscaler capex | Holding high, no guide-down | Bull |
| Custom ASIC shift | Accelerating (OpenAI/Trainium, AVGO) | Mixed (NVDA bear, AVGO/CRDO bull) |
| Optical/InP supply | Tight; CRDO +157% rev | Bull; CRDO beat offset by -12% reaction |
| Solar — Section 232 | Decision imminent | Tactical bull for FSLR |

---

## Most important development

**AVGO Q2 FY2026 (June 3):** AI revenue at record $10.8B and Q3 AI guidance of $16B confirm the custom-silicon supercycle is intact. The post-earnings decline (software miss, no FY2027 target raise) is a sentiment check, not a thesis break. Key watch: if AVGO delivers ~$16B AI revenue in Q3, that resets valuation floors for MRVL, CRDO, and ALAB. Separately, the HBM ASP softening print from SK Hynix is the first live data point validating the baseline's most important risk — watch for further price compression signals in Q3-2026 as all three suppliers expand capacity.

Not investment advice. Forward figures are forecasts.
